hypotheses.name: Cross-domain scGPT H1 persistence replication
hypotheses.method: Executed conda run -n subproject40-topology python iterations/iter_0004/run_iter0004_screen.py to compute ripser H1 lifetime sums on immune/external-lung layer embeddings (3 seeds/domain, 350 genes/layer, PCA20) with 20 feature-shuffle null replicates per seed-layer and Fisher-combined p-values per layer.
hypotheses.result_value: immune=12/12 layers (1.00), external_lung=12/12 layers (1.00); mean layer delta immune=12.074, external_lung=12.482
hypotheses.next_action: Stress-test top layers with stronger nulls (distance permutation and kNN rewiring) and then run source/target-disjoint split robustness.

hypotheses.name: Intrinsic-dimensionality coupling with H1 topology by layer
hypotheses.method: Within the same run, computed per seed-layer participation-ratio dimension, top-5 linearity ratio, and Levina-Bickel MLE intrinsic dimension, then tested layer-wise Spearman correlations to H1 delta with 2000 layer-permutation nulls and Fisher combination across seeds.
hypotheses.result_value: external_lung: participation_ratio rho=0.508 (p=0.0229), linearity_top5 rho=-0.510 (p=0.0178); immune metrics p>=0.147
hypotheses.next_action: Replace unstable local-ID estimator, include lung in the same protocol, and test robustness of sign/magnitude under stronger neighborhood definitions.
